summary.overview: The Family Health Optima Insurance Plan by Star Health is a comprehensive family floater policy offering hospitalization, day care, and modern treatment covers. Key strengths include automatic sum insured restoration, recharge benefits, and loyalty bonuses.
best_for: Families seeking comprehensive floater coverage with broad medical inclusions
Policyholders looking for wellness reward programs and health check-ups
Seniors and adults wanting coverage with built-in automatic restoration features
watch_outs: Mandatory 20% co-payment for insured persons entering at age 61 and above
Room rent limits and proportionate deductions on associated medical expenses for lower sum insured tiers
Strict claim submission timeline of 15 days from discharge for reimbursement claims
next_actions: Review the room rent limit corresponding to your chosen Sum Insured
Complete the initial Health Risk Assessment and wellness activities via the Star Health app to earn renewal discounts
Note down emergency and planned hospitalization intimation timelines to avoid claim rejections

risks.title: 20% co-payment: Age 61 and above
risks.explanation: A 20% co-payment applies when this condition is met (20% co-payment for age 61 and above).
risks.quote: This policy is subject to co-payment of 20% of each and every claim amount for fresh as well as renewal policies for Insured Persons whose age at the time of entry is 61 years and above.

risks.title: Room-rent limit with proportionate deduction
risks.explanation: Room rent is capped (Up to Rs. 2,000/- per day for SI 1 Lakh; Up to Rs. 5,000/- per day for SI 3 Lakh & 4 Lakh; Single Standard A/C Room for SI 5 Lakh and above). Choosing a costlier room can reduce the payout for the whole bill (doctor fees, tests) in the same proportion.

risks.title: Pre-existing diseases covered only after 3 years
risks.explanation: Any illness you had before buying the policy is not covered until this period of continuous cover is complete.
risks.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-Existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage

risks.title: 10% co-payment: Voluntary Co-payment
risks.explanation: A 10% co-payment applies when this condition is met (Optional voluntary co-payment of 10% or 20%).
risks.quote: If the Insured Person chooses voluntary co-payment, the Company will provide a discount on premium as per the table given below; Co-payment % | Discount % 10% | 10% 20% | 20%

risks.title: 2 years wait for listed diseases/procedures
risks.explanation: Treatments on the specific list (e.g. Cataract, Benign diseases of the breast, Hysterectomy, Joint Replacement) are not covered in this period.
risks.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the following listed Conditions, surgeries/ treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage

risks.title: Sub-limit: Cataract
risks.explanation: This expense is capped at Cataract limit ranges from Rs. 12,000 per eye to Rs. 50,000 per eye depending on Sum Insured even if your sum insured is higher.
risks.quote: Expenses incurred on treatment of Cataract is subject to the limit as per the following table

risks.title: Sub-limit: Road Ambulance
risks.explanation: This expense is capped at Road ambulance up to Rs. 750 per hospitalization and Rs. 1,500 per Policy Period even if your sum insured is higher.
risks.quote: road ambulance expenses up to Rs.750/- per hospitalization and up to Rs.1,500/- per Policy Period

risks.title: Emergency admission must be reported within 24 hours
risks.explanation: Late intimation can delay or complicate the claim.
risks.quote: Within 24 hours of date and time of Hospitalization if the Insured Person has been hospitalized in an Emergency.

risks.title: Strict Reimbursement Submission Timeline
risks.explanation: Reimbursement claims for hospitalization must be filed within 15 days of discharge, which is a tight window.
risks.quote: Claim must be filed within 15 days from the date of dis- charge from the Hospital
